composition.serve_who: This is an equipment photograph of a spare-parts bag containing Harken needle roller bearings (P/N A72931800, 120x126x19mm, QTY 2). The PO reference "SWS108#1 ID13398" ties this directly to the vessel project SWS108. No specific winch/equipment name is printed on the label — bearings of this size (120x126x19) are consistent with Harken's larger self-tailing/captive winch drive assemblies. Given the register lists several distinct Harken winch nodes (mast, primary, secondary, captive) without a definitive match callout on this label, and no drawn/printed line ties it to one specific unit, this spare part record is best attached to the general Harken winch spares pool. Since the register offers a captive winch node explicitly (220-captive-mainsheet-9t, Harken Air Captive 9T) which is the largest winch aboard and the most likely candidate for a bearing of this size, but the label gives no explicit equipment callout, this is recorded as an uncertainty rather than forced onto one specific winch node.
